name: My subscriptions
description: Customers view and manage their SaleLoop subscriptions.

page.heading: My subscriptions
page.subheading: Skip, pause, change or cancel your subscriptions anytime.

list.emptyBody: When you subscribe to a product, you'll manage it here.

detail.skippedBody: Your order on {{date}} won't be sent or charged.
detail.failedHeading: Your last payment didn't go through
detail.failedBody: {{reason}} ({{date}}). Update your payment method so your next order isn't missed.

manage.heading: Manage subscription
manage.body: Skip an order, take a break, or cancel. No need to contact the store.

skip.heading: Skip your next order?
skip.body: Your order on {{date}} won't be sent or charged. Later orders continue as usual.

pause.heading: Pause your subscription?
pause.body: No orders are sent or charged while it's paused. Resume anytime from this page.

cancel.heading: Cancel your subscription?
cancel.body: No more orders will be sent or charged. Orders already placed aren't affected. This can't be undone.

done.payment: Check your email for a secure link

frequency.heading: Delivery frequency
frequency.label: Deliver every
frequency.note: Your next order date and price update to match.

payment.heading: Payment method
payment.updateHelp: We'll email you a secure link from the store to update your card.

address.heading: Delivery address
address.required: Enter the address, city and a 2-letter country/region code.
address.noShipping: This store doesn't ship your subscription to that address.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the store. Check your connection and try again.
